$comment: Deploy-surface manifest for the pipeline's Deploy stage (deploy/pipeline/plan-surfaces.py reads it; scripts/check-deploy-surfaces.sh enforces that every lambda/*, deploy/* and src/config/*.json surface is listed here). A surface deploys when any file in pipeline-out/changed-files.txt starts with one of its `paths`. CODE ONLY: the pipeline updates Lambda code, harness prompt/model/skills and S3 toolkits — never IAM, env vars or infra. Infra scripts are `handoff` (the Deploy stage exits 2 after a good app deploy so the release manager reports them as a human step).

lambdas.note: REPORT_VERSION is 5 (card.kpi, kpiVersion 1). If REPORT_VERSION or kpiVersion changed, run lambda/cost-report/deploy.sh --backfill [--since-days N] by hand: --rebuild-index alone drops every card that is not at the current REPORT_VERSION, so a bump REQUIRES --backfill or the fleet index empties.
Only @aws-sdk/client-s3 is declared, which the nodejs20.x runtime provides — deploy/setup-tickets-lambda.mjs ships index.mjs alone too.
Absent in TICKET_PROVIDER=jira installs — skipped when the function does not exist.

runtimes.$comment: Runtime-image CD (buildspec-runtime-images.yml): a change to a BAKED file rebuilds this runtime's arm64 image and image-swaps it via update-runtime-image.py (env/lifecycle/role/EFS preserved). Prompts (deploy/runtime-agent/prompts/) are NOT baked — they ship via Target 2's S3 sync and load at cold start, so they are not listed here.
runtimes.name: agentcore_hub_agent

runtimes.$comment: Instances (EC2 + per-session EBS) twin of the coding runtime: same image, same baked files. buildspec-runtime-images.yml builds one image per (ecrRepo, context) and swaps it into every runtime listing that pair.
runtimes.name: agentcore_hub_coding_runtime_ec2

excluded.lambda/orchestrator: Target 1 of buildspec-deploy.yml (one zip to orchestrator + agent-invoker + events-writer).
excluded.lambda/builder-tools: No deployed function — the builder harness uses code_interpreter; source kept for reference.
excluded.deploy/pipeline: The pipeline itself; buildspec/stack edits take effect on the next run or via deploy/pipeline/deploy.sh.
excluded.deploy/ecs-express: The app image is Target 3 (roll-by-digest); deploy.sh is the pre-pipeline manual path.
excluded.deploy/config.sh: Sourced by scripts; not a deploy surface.
excluded.deploy/runtime-agent/healthcheck-fixture: Fixtures for the fleet healthcheck (setup-healthcheck.sh); not baked, not deployed.
excluded.deploy/runtime-agent/test-streaming: Standalone OTEL span-test runtime; deployed out of band by its own deploy.sh.
excluded.deploy/runtime-agent/verify-fleet-invoke: Fleet smoke tool; run by hand.
excluded.deploy/runtime-agent/verify-fleet.sh: Fleet smoke tool; run by hand.
excluded.deploy/lib: Sourced shell helpers for the opt-in config-evals deploy guard (require_eval_gate, --force parsing). Library code consumed by the deploy scripts at run time — nothing to deploy.
excluded.src/config/agents.json: NOT a plain cp — Target 2 of buildspec-deploy.yml MERGES the repo copy onto the S3 copy via merge-agents-json.py (the S3 version carries deploy-injected runtimeArns the repo nulls out); it ships on every deploy, unconditionally.
excluded.src/config/cd-registry.json: Target 2 seeds config/cd-registry.json only when ABSENT — the S3 copy is the live document (edited via the Workflow tab / scripts/cd-registry.sh), so it must never be cp'd over.
excluded.src/config/lease-constants.json: Baked into pipeline-out/orchestrator.zip by buildspec-ci.yml (copied in beside lease.mjs before the zip, per lambda/orchestrator/deploy.sh's own file list), and Target 1 ships that zip on every run — nothing separate to deploy.
excluded.src/config/liveness-constants.json: Not an S3 config surface — deploy/workflow-manager/deploy.sh bakes it into the workflow-analyzer zip. NOTE: the analyzer's manifest `files` list does not yet carry it, so a change to this file does not reach prod through the pipeline; tracked as a follow-up against PR #407 / TEAM-4160.
excluded.deploy/coding-agent-runtime/probe-instan: Instances runtime probe/benchmark (cold/pin/fs/turn/persist/cleanup); run by hand, not deployed.
